rules.counterWindow: once between consecutive own turn starts

randomGeneration.iterationOrder: coordinates ascending q, then r; players ascending P index
randomGeneration.templateSource: fixedMaps matching size and participant count
randomGeneration.fallback: matching fixed map, exposed as fixed_fallback

noise.smoothing: floor(mean(self and six in-map neighbors)), synchronous update

hashContract: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON of {id,size,radius,playerCount,terrain,buildings,initialUnits,seats,deposits}, recursively sorted object keys; array order is preserved; no whitespace. Metrics and contentHash excluded.
